text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't talk to me right now. I'm doing the 
final checks.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left is to run the program. 
I'll show 'em what my code can do."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Also, it's fine to talk to me now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Don't take your eyes off her either, 
got it?
